_what: M6, open coding of the hand-back reports (mine, after M1-M5 were in). For each maker who looked: what its report says the looks showed. DEFECT = something wrong was seen (fixed or named as left); CONFIRM = the look is reported as showing the work as intended; SURPRISE = something about the material or form not anticipated, acted on; SILENT = the report names a render but not what it showed. For N makers: how the maker checked its work without the viewer. Quotes are verbatim from reports/.

m01.quote: The last render (`renders/04.png`) shows no page errors and nothing overlaps.

m03.quote: Two things are still rough in that render. The labels are tightly stacked over the crowded post-1950 area, and some leader lines cross stones.
m03.note: defects seen at the last look and left

m04.quote: The first render had two problems. The heap ran wall to wall like a roof, and the stone names came out dark when they were meant to be light.

m05.quote: The last one, `renders/04.png`, shows no page errors and nothing clipped.

m07.quote: Two leader lines in the second row of labels run through first-row text
m07.note: defects seen at the last look and left; coder 2 found the same leader line (f11)

m08.quote: The last check was the viewer's render 09, at 1100 × 800.
m08.note: nine looks; the report names none of what they showed. Also reports reading the viewer's code, outside its folder (F-207).

m09.quote: The first two renders failed: one stacked the stones into towers, the next had Hoba balanced on a column of pebbles and running off the top of the frame. Rolling the big stones further fixed both.

m10.quote: I rendered it twice with the viewer; the second render (`renders/02.png`) shows the final version
m10.note: the coder rated its pair 1 (dust grains added); the report names the grains as 'one departure from strict scale', not as something a look showed

m02.quote: I checked the layout and every label position by running the page's script in Node with a stand-in canvas. No browser was available, so I have not seen the actual rendered image.

m06.quote: I rendered it once in a headless browser: there were no errors, and the layout looks the way I intended.
m06.note: wrote a screenshot into its folder and deleted it

m11.quote: I never saw a picture of it: I only measured the layout numerically in a headless browser, because saving a screenshot would have meant writing a file outside the two you allowed.

m12.quote: I couldn't look at it as an image, because there was no browser or image library here. I checked it by running the page script against a stand-in canvas that estimates text widths
m12.note: its label 'no year recorded (22)' counts only the stones it draws (38 items have no year)

material_notes: Agpalilik's coordinates in Copenhagen were named by m01, m02, m03, m06, m07 and m10 (looking and not looking alike), found by reading the data, not at a look. Q65130721 (no label) was named by nine.
